usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/baseten/v1/chat/completions with OpenAI-compatible JSON body {model, messages[], optional max_tokens/temperature/etc.}
usage.outputShape: body.choices[0].message.content (assistant text); reasoning models also fill body.choices[0].message.reasoning_content; token counts at body.usage
quirks: Both `model` and `messages` are REQUIRED. Valid model slugs include: openai/gpt-oss-120b, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1, zai-org/GLM-4.6, zai-org/GLM-4.7, moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905, moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Thinking, moonshotai/Kimi-K2.5.

Reasoning-capable models (gpt-oss, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi-Thinking) emit a separate `message.reasoning_content` field that consumes the token budget. With a tiny max_tokens (e.g. 16) the model spends all tokens on reasoning, leaving `message.content` empty and finish_reason='length'. Set max_tokens high enough (256+) to get real answer text.
OpenAI-compatible: supports streaming (stream:true -> SSE), tools, response_format/json_schema, reasoning_effort (low/medium/high) for reasoning models.
usage.guide: POST a standard OpenAI chat-completions JSON body to https://x402.orth.sh/baseten/v1/chat/completions; payment is handled via x402 (USDC on Base, ~$0.001-0.004/call). You MUST include both `model` (a valid slug like openai/gpt-oss-120b or deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1) and `messages`. Read the answer at body.choices[0].message.content. Note that reasoning models split output into reasoning_content + content, so request a generous max_tokens (256+) or content may come back empty with finish_reason='length'.
